comments.author: Xiao Wei
comments.body: what can make loyalty go down, I got food water ammo timber and still it drops

comments.author: Shirin
comments.body: Make sure you have money on you to pay their wages.

comments.author: Cornelia
comments.body: Also keep their fatigue low, especially if you're using Frugality skill. Once that skill gets to about r8+ their loyalty loss will begin to slow

comments.author: Sonia
comments.body:
well lets see here. Several things make loyalty decrease.

no money to pay wages.
disasters. (the longer you let them go on, the more loyalty you lose)
losing a sea battle.
frugality. (some people will say it doesn't, but I have watched loyalty drop by using this)
extended sailing time. (I think this depends on total levels, but if you stay out for 100+ days it will become an issue)

comments.author: Laurencio
comments.body: hmmm.. disaster, not enough money to pay wages, not enough provisions, frugality (yes it does reduce loyalty and even ship speed), hmmm what else.. i think that covers it up all?
